tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shes rab snang ba'i sgrub thabs phag mo dkar mo bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// de la mtshan mo'i thun phyed kyi rjes la/ cho ga bzhin du langs te dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas tsan dan mchog la sogs pas byugs nas/ me tog sna tshogs pas nye bar mdzes par byas la mngon du gyur pa'i ro yi gdan kyang rung ste/ ji ltar bde bar 'dug nas/ byams pa la sogs mngon du 'gro bas rang gi snying khar a'i rnam pa las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi yig ge hrīḥdakar po'i 'od zer gyi dra bas rab tu gsal bar byas nas/ rdo rje phag mos gtso byas pa'i bla ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mdun du gnas ji ltar bar yang dag par blta la snying kha'i sa bon las 'thon pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod yon la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ slan chad mi byed par bsdoms pa dang*/ bsod nams la rjes su yi rangs ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ lam brten pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi dngos po 'bul ba dang*/ bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa rnams cho ga bzhin du byas shing bsod nams yongs su bsngos te stong pa nyid kyi ye shes rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad sems can la sangs rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pa sngon du song bas/ oṃ swa bha bā shu dho sarba dharma swa bha bha shud dho ham̐/ zhes brjod de thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wa ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o// de nas rang gi sems pam̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ pad ma'i steng du a las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/

yi ge hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hrīḥdakar pos mtshan pa bsgoms nas/ spro ba dang bsdu ba sngon du 'gro bas/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ me tog sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ skra phyed grol zhing phyed bcings pas mdzes pa/ rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba gnyis kyi dbus su thod pa yi phreng ba bcings pa'i zur phud gsum pa can/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna rgyan dang*/ mgul brgyan dang*/ gdug gu dang 'og phag gi brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa na ba dan yongs su bskyod pa'i mdzes pa'i rdo rje mi shes pa'i skyes bu 'jig par byed pa mo/ g.yon gyi gru khugs na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga'i yu ba dkar po/ mgo bo rtse bzhi pa/ steng nag po rtse lnga pa/ rjes su 'brel ba'i mgo bo skam po dang*/ rnying pa dang rlon pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ gser gyi bum pa'i rtsa ba la btags pa'i dril bu phra mo'i sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ sna tshogs ba dan gyis mdzes pa'i yu ba dpung pa la brten pa/ phyag g.yon na bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i pad ma'i snod bsnams pa mo/ khrag 'dzag cing brlan dang bcas pa'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang ba*/ pad ma dmar po'i steng na nyi ma la gnas pa'i shes pa dang bral ba'i skyes bu la/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyi zhabs kyis bzhugs pa/ na bza' dang bral ba/ rab tu gtum pa'i nyi ma'i 'od can ma/ ba spu'i phreng ba las 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba can/ gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs kyis phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa/ thugs khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hrīḥyis mtshan pa bsgom par bya'o// de sngags kyi phreng ba bgrang phreng gi rnam pa dkar po/

'khor lo 'khor ba'i sbyor bas zhal gyi nang nas 'thon nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi tshogs dang*/ nor bu dang sngags dang*/ sman dang*/ zla ba dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ bstan chos dang sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i nus mthu rnams blangs te sngags kyi 'khor lo la gzhug cing rang gzhan gyis mi shes pa thams cad bsreg pa'i bdag nyid can du bsgom par bya'o// oṃ yo ga shu dha sarba dharma yo ga shud dho haṃ/ zhes brjod la sa bon de'i 'od kyi spyan drangs pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lngas bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nyid de// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol gyis// ces bdag nyid la dbang bskur nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ ces byin gyis brlabs la/ spyi bor sna tshogs pad ma nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan pa bsam mo// de nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag nyid la mchod cing bstod par bsams nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ dro ba'i mthar gnas yi ge la// me'i bus ni 'og tu brgyan// nga ro gsum pa steng du sbyin// mthar ni tsheg drag sbyar te bzla// gang gi tshe langs par 'dod pa de'i tshe sngags kyi phreng ba lte bar gnas pa'i yi ge la bstims la/ mchod pa sngon du 'gro bar smon lam gdab ste/ bsod nams yongs su bsngos nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de/ lha mo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas chos thams cad de'i tshul du rdzogs par lta zhing ci bde bar gnas par bya'o// nam phyed kyi thun la ni thams cad sngar bzhin byas nas/ nyal ba'i tshe sngas su bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bltas nas mchod la/ seng ge'i nyal thabs kyis nyal bar bya'o// nang par snga dro'i thun la ni/ lha mo rnams kyis bslang pas langs te sngar bzhin du bya'o// gtor ma ni gzhan dang 'dra'o// de ltar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas/

'bum phrag bdun bzlas na bstan chos thams cad dang*/ sgyu rtsal gyi tshogs rnams mngon par shes par 'gyur ro// yid gzhungs pa dang rtul phod pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ 'khor gyis zil mi gnon pa dang*/ smra mkhas par 'gyur ro// rims nad dang*/ dug dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i gnod pa med par 'gyur ro// gang gi lag tu byin pa de rmongs pa yin yang mnyan sngags mkhan du 'gyur ro// shes rab snang ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ko ka sbyin gyis mdzad pa las/ rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa rdzogs so// ༈ //me mchod bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyin bsreg byed par 'dod pas/ lha gang yang rung ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi bca' gzhi yongs su rdzogs nas/ cho ga'i rim pa ni thog mar sems bskyed/ thab bsangs/ me sbar te/ oṃ ag ne ye dhe ba ha ba bh+ya/ ka ba bh+ya bhan dha ye/ dhi bh+ya dh+ya pa ta ye dza la ram̐/ zhes pas me sbar/ de nas mar gyi dgang blugs gsum phul la/ pra brtag /zhi rgyas la sgra med pa'i dkar ser mchog tu bzang*/ dbang drag la dmar nag sgra dang bcas pa bzang*/ ltas mi bzang pa la yi dam lha'i sngags kyis bsang*/ de nas me lha bskyed par bya ste/ zhal cig phyag bzhi/ g.yas dbyug tho mchod sbyin/ g.yon bgrang phreng dang ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ las gang byed pa'i kha dog dang mthun par bskyed/ de la chu gsum 'bul bar bya ste/ oṃ ag ne ye dhe ba ta/ a r+gham̐ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ ghan dham̐ dang*/ pa t+yam̐ pra ti dz+wa ye swāhā/ zhes phul la spyan drangs pa ni/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs su gsol// ag ne ye dhe ba ta sa ma ya dza dza/ sa ma ya ti sta lhan zhes spyan drangs zhing bzhugs su gsol/ de nas ag ne ye dhe ba ta ye swā hā/

zhes mar 'bul/ oṃ a pra ti ha sta badz+ra ya swā hā/ yam shing ngo*// oṃ badz+ra a yu she swā hā/ 'jag ma'o// oṃ badz+ra yag nya ye swā hā/ dur ba'o// oṃ sarba pa pam̐ da dha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ til lo// oṃ sarba sta bhan yā+e swā hā/ zho zan no// oṃ badz+ra bhi dza ye swāhā/ so ba'o// oṃ mahā bhe ga ye swā hā/ nas so// oṃ badz+ra gha sma ri ye swā hā/ gro'o// oṃ mahā pa la ye swā hā/ sran ma'o// oṃ badz+ra phu tra ye swā hā/ 'bras so// oṃ badz+ra ti pa la ye swā hā/ dar dkar dang rgya shug la sogs pa'o// de nas mchod pa ci rigs su phul la/ bstod pa ni/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad ster mdzad pa/ bdag gzhan don brtson sa la zhugs// tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// me lha'i rgyal po dge ba mchog /tshangs sras 'jig rten skyong ba'i sras// bgegs rnams ma lus sel mdzad pa// gzi brjid chen po nyid la 'dud/ nyon mongs bsreg pa'i ye shes 'od// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams sel mdzad pa'i// thugs rje chen po nyid la 'dud// bden pa'i tshig ni mi bslu bas/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi rgyal// tshangs par gyur pa'i ngag dang ldan// rnam par 'dren pa nyid la 'dud// drang srong chen po khyed rnams kyis// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// dam bca' bzhin du me yi las/ nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes bstod do// de nas me lha gdan thabs kyis rgya bskyed pa'am/ me nyid du bsgyur ba gang 'thad pa byas la/ lha gang byed pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal bar byas la/ 'ga' zhig la chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba bya/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ bzhugs su gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ de nas rtsa ba'i snying po'i bsham du gong gi bsreg rdzas kyi bsham du btags te/ ci rigs su 'bul zhing 'phrin las rnam bzhi so sor/

shan ting ku ru/ pus ting ku ru/ pa sham̐ ku ru/ ma ra ya phaṭa ces sbyar ro// de nas gzhung so so nas bshad pa'i mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ 'phrin las bzhi so so'i gsol ba gdab cing*/ bshags pa/ smon lam/ gshegs su gsol ba la sogs bya'o// dam tshig pa rang gi gnas su bsdu'o// me lha la drin lan gyi tshul du/ slar bsreg rdzas ci rigs su 'bul/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ bdag so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i dbang gis rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ tshig la lhag chad du gyur pa rnams drang srong chen po la bzod par gsol lo// zhes brjod la rgyas par byed pa'am/ sbyin bdag la sogs pas zhu ba yin na/ rdo rje rgya gram cig bzos nas/ thab dkyil du bcug ste/ rdzas rnams bsdus te/ gong gi hab bh+ya kab bh+ya la sogs pa'i sngags kyi rjes su/ shan ting ku ru/ pus ting ku ru/ pa sham̐ ku ru ma ra ya phaṭa la sogs pas/ bsreg rdzas su 'bul zhing*/ 'phrin las bzhi'i smon lam brjod par bya'o// de nas/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol// rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// ag ne ye dha ba ta badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod la gshegs su gsol lo// bkra shis brjod/ dge ba bsngo zhing*/ zhi rgyas kyi thal ba chu chen po'i 'gram du bskyal/ dbang drag la mnan pa'am rlung la sbyar ro// yang na so so nas bshad pa ltar bya'o// sbyin bsreg thams cad kyi spyi'i dbye ba'am kha skongs kyi rim pa rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du shog// / ༈ dpal dril bu pas mdzad pa'i gzhung gsum gyi sa bcad bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ dbang gi cho ga 'di la gsum ste/ mtshan gyi don dang*/ gzhung don dang*/ mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam mo// gzhung la gnyis/

spyir dbang gi rnam gzhag dang*/ dbang gi cho ga'o// dang po la bzhi/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i 'thad pa/ lus kyi rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la bzhi/ bcos ma'i ngo bo/ de mkhas pa'i spang byar gdams pa/ de'i 'thad pa bshad pa/ kun rdzob tu dbang bskur dgos pa'i tshul lo// dbang gi cho ga gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug bsdu ba'o// sngon 'gro la lnga/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ lus dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ dam tshig rnam gnyis bsgrag pa dang*/ rjes dang*/ 'dug stangs dang*/ sngags gsum gyis ye shes dbab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ 'di la gsum/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ tshigs bcad dang*/ don rgyas bshad do// dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bum dbang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang bcas pa dang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'o/ dang po la gsum/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// dbang bskur ba dngos la bdun/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gi dbang dang*/ bskur ba'i dgos pa dang*/ sngags dang rdo rje brtul zhugs/ thun mong khyad par dang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod pa'o// rdo rje slob dpon la gsum/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba'o/ bar pa la lnga/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ lhag par gnas shing mchod pa dang*/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ rjes gnang ngo*// de la gnyis/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang*/ gzhan don gyi rjes gnang ngo*// gnyis pa gsang dbang la gsum ste*/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// de la lnga/ phyag rgya dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgrub pa dang*/ rtog pa gzhom pa dang*/ lan gdab pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas te sbyin pa dngos so// dbang gsum pa la bdun/

gsol ba gdab pa/ gsum pa'i rten tshigs bcad dang bcas te sbyin pa/ dam tshig dri ba/ lan dang lhan cig skyes pa'i don gyi dri ba dang*/ lan/ rjes gnang ngo*// bzhi pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// mjug bsdu ba la gnyis/ mjug bsdud dngos dang*/ zhar la de kho na nyid bstan pa'o/ dbang gi bsdus don rdzogs so// na mo shri tsa kra saṃ bha ra/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'di la gnyis te/ mtshan don dang*/ gzhung gi don no// de la gsum ste/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ nyams su blang ba'o// byin brlabs la gsum/ rim gnyis dbyer med du nyams su blang ba'i phyir/ bskyed rim bstan pa dang*/ de nyid nang du gnas pas bcos ma spang ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dngos so/ de la lnga/ bla ma gal che bar gdams pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i yon tan dang*/ mngon zhen bzlog pa dang*/ skad cig tu byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ de rgyud du sbas pa'i tshul lo// nyams su blang ba la lnga/ byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa sna tshogs rdo rje/ nor bu 'gengs pa/ dza lan dha ra/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sa bon dang bcas pa dang*/ sa bon med pa'o// dang po la gsum/ sa bon dang bcas pa'i dngos gzhi dang*/ yan lag dang*/ phan yon no// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no// sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa la gnyis sa bon dang bcas pa dang*/ sa bon med pa'o// dang po la gsum/ dngos gzhi dang*/ yan lag dbang po la dgod pa dang*/ 'khor lo la dgod pa phan yon dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no// nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa la bzhi/ mtshams sbyar zhing*/ dngos dang*/ phan yon gyis/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ de bzhin du las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ chos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya chen po phan yon dang bcas pa'o// dza lan dha ra'i rim pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no// rim pa lnga pa la drug

/sems bzung ba dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du bzhag pa dang*/ stong nyid dang bsre ba dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mngon du mdzad tshul dang*/ phan yon no/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bsdus don/ rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ //dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub thabs 'di la don gsum ste/ mtshan gyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug gi don no// gzhung la gnyis/ nyams su len pa po rten gyi gang zag dang*/ nyams su blang bya dngos so// de la gnyis/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'o// lam la gnyis te/ dngos gzhi mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes mnyam par ma bzhag pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed rims dang*/ rdzogs rims so// bskyed rims la gnyis/ lus dang*/ yan lag go /dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gsum/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ lus ngag yid gsum dag par bya ba/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rten bskyed dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa'o// de la gsum/ gtso bo bskyed pa dang*/ 'khor bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed pa'i yan lag go /dang po la gsum/ yab kyi rnam pa dang*/ yum dang*/ gnyis su med par bstan pa'o// 'khor bskyed pa la gsum/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dang*/ 'khor lo gzhan mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la lnga ste/ thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'o// bskyed pa'i yan lag la bzhi/ dag pa dang*/ go cha gnyis bsgo ba dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// bzlas pa la gnyis/ bzlas pa dngos dang tshul ci ltar bzla ba'o// yan lag la gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang 'brel pa'i spyod pa/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ rdzas dang*/ dus dang sngags gsum gyi gtor ma'o// rjes mnyam par ma bzhag pa la gnyis/ rang don thabs dang shes rab kyi spyod pa/

zhar la bcom ldan 'das ma'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o// dpal rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi bsdus don rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ //dril bu pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang*// he ru ka dpal phag mor bcas// gus pas btud de dbang bskur gyi// mtshams sbyor 'dir ni bshad par bya// dpal rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i dbang gi cho ga 'di la gsum las/ mtshan gyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam mo// dang po ni rgya gar skad nas/ phyag 'tshal lo'i bar lo ts+tsha ba'i ngag yin no// gzhung la gnyis te/ spyir dbang gi rnam bzhag dang*/ bskur ba'i cho ga'o// dang po la bzhi las/ bshad par dam bca' ba ni/ tshig bzhi pa/ khams gsum gyi sems can 'khor ba na gnas pa las thar bar byed pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyis dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang*/ mthar thug pa thun mong ma yin pa'i lam nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa'i rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa yin cing*/ de yang sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo gsum gyi rim pa gnyis la rten nas/ tshe gcig nyid la rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god pa yin la/ de la yang smin par byed pa'i dbang dgos pas/ 'dir rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i dbang gi cho ga bshad par bya'o// zhes bya ba'o// dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i 'thad pa ni/ dbang bskur zhes pa'i tshig bzhi ste/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rim pas/ dbang sngon du 'gro bar rgyud mang por gsungs shing*/ bye brag tu yang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med// bye ma btsir kyang mar med ltar// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang de yang rdo rje slob dpon yon tan du ma dang ldan pa cig gis bla ma rgyud pa'i rim pa las ji ltar 'ongs ba bzhin bskur bar bya'o// de'ang gang zag gi rim pas/

dbang po rab kyi tha ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la rten nas bskur gyi/ 'bring dang rab kyi lus dang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du ci ltar rung zhe na/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor mdor gsungs pa/ sems la gnas pa zhes tshig bzhis bstan te/ de yang don dam par/ phyi rol gyi thig dang rdul tshon la ltos pa nang du bdag nyid kyi sems dang lus la gnas te/ nges brjod las/ ku lu ta'i rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang dkyil 'khor thig /sin dhu rdo rje thig zlum po// pu ri ra ma la pad ma// zhes pas so// de bzhin du lus kyi gnas dkyil 'khor du sbyar ba rgyas par bdag gi bla mas mdzad pa yod pas 'dir ma bkod pa yin no// lus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bshad pa ni/ bzhi pa bcos pa'i ngo bo ni/ tshig gnyis te/ phyi rol gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni gdul bya 'jug pa'i phyir yin zhes pa'o// de mkhas pa'i spang byar bstan te/ mkhas pa zhes tshig gnyis so// de'i 'thad pa bshad pa ni/ tshig bzhi ste/ rgyud las lus 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid du gsungs pas lha grub la/ rim pa 'dis dbang gi dkyil 'khor yang lus la grub pa ste/ de ngo sprad pa'i phyir dbang bskur ba yin no// thog ma nas ma grub pa grub par byed pa ni ma yin/ ces so// kha cig gis ci nas ma grub pa yang grub byed zer ba ni ma yin te/ dang po nas ma grub pa cig grub par byed mi nus te/ sol ba la dkar po bzhin no/ dang po nas grub na mi dgos so zhe na de yang ma yin te/ shun pa dang bcas pa'i nor bu bzhin no// des na kun rdzob tu dbang bskur dgos pa'i tshul ni/ tshig bzhis lus sems la gnas pa de mi shes pas shes par byed pa la snod du byed ces bya ba 'dis/ kun rdzob tsam du dbang bskur dgos par grub bo zhes bya ba'o// dbang gi cho ga la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ slob dpon zhes tshig bzhi ste/

ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang rang la du yod zhe na/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes/ tshig dbang dang bzhi'o// de yang bcu bzhir 'gyur ba ni/ tsar+ya pas/ me tog chu yi dbang bskur dang*// cod pan rdo rje'i bdag po dang*// ming dang sngags dang brtul zhugs dang*// gnang dang dam tshig gzengs bstod dang*// gsang dang phyag rgya gtad pa ste// zhes gsungs pa'am/ yang na bzhi pa dang*/ bcu bzhi'o// de'i rim pa'i dbang bskur ba rgyas par bshad pa ni gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po ni slob dpon 'di'i bzhed kyis lus dkyil 'khor du grub pas sa chog mi dgos/ de tsa na slob ma'i yang lus dkyil 'khor du grub par ngo 'phrod pas slob ma sta gon kyang rgyas par mi dgos mod kyis/ 'on kyang gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ni 'di ltar yin te/ dus khyad par can la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma zung du ma gyur pa gang yod pas gsol ba gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ yo byad rnams sta gon bya ste/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis bum sman chu gtsang ma dang bcas pas nang bkang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yang gzhug cing*/ kha rgyan mgul chings legs par bya ste/ ras la sogs pa gtsang ma'i steng du/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du bzhugs/ mchod pas bskor/ gzhan yang me tog phreng ba dang rdo rje dril bu dbu rgyan/ tshangs skud/ thod pa bdud rtsi lngas bkang pa/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga spyan yol la sogs pa rnams 'tshogs par byas te/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzus skyes su bskyed la zlas pa cung zad byas te slar chu'i rnam par bsgyur la/ las thams cad kyi bum par yi ge ḍa naṃ khan dha ro ha bskyed la bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de rnams ni bum pa sta gon no// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma yang bshams te bzhag go

/de'i 'og tu bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bsgrub pa ni/ dang por re shig 'khor lo gsum// rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid dmigs// zhes pa bdag bskyed nas/ dbang blang ba'i bar byas te/ slob ma 'jug pa ni yol ba'i phyi rol du phyag byas nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'dug ste/ slob dpon gyis khyed su yin ces dri'o// slob mas/ kye bde ba chen po bdag ni skal pa bzang po'o// zhes so// khyed ci 'dod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig nod 'tshal lo/ zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ de ltar yin phan chad khyed rnams theg pa bla na med pa 'dir 'jug par bya ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang lam khyad par can 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas pa yin no// zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ bcos ma dang lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba cung zad bshad la las bum gyis bkrus te/ gdong g.yogs la nang du bcug ste/ bgegs la a ka ros gtor ma gcig byin nas/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur la sogs pa dmigs te/ de nas slob ma rnams rnam snang gi rang bzhin he ru ka dkar po zhal cig phyag gnyis par bsgom du bcug ste/ snying khar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa sgom du bcug ste/ de'i snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsi ta u pa ta ya mi/ su ra ta sa ma ya stam/ si dha badz+ra ya tha su kham̐ zhes brjod nas/ de ltar sngags kyi smon 'jug gi rang bzhin du sems bskyed pas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs kyis/ gzhan ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod kyis ma dad par yang mi bya'o// zhes brjod nas/ spros pa la dga' na bgegs sbyang ba ni/ slob ma'i rkang mthil du yam̐/ rkang bol du raṃ/ de'i steng du hūm̐ bsams te/ rlung gis me spar bas/ snying khar kam̐ la gnod byed sdig pa'i gzugs su bsgyur la/

hūm̐ rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pas sna sgo'i lam nas deng nas mer bsregs rgya mtshor dor bar bsams te/ til la bstim zhing*/ me la bsregs chu blugs la sgo drung du dor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta kri lo kya bi dza ya kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pa pam̐ dha ha na ba smi ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod do// de nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang dkyil 'khor dang dbyer med pa la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// don dam rnal 'byor smra ba'i seng ge zhes bya ba// nyon mongs spyod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed rtsa'i nyon mongs chom mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang rang bzhin du gnas pa dbyer med pa la gsol gdab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes brjod nas slob ma la/ dam tshig 'bog pa ni/ da khyed rnams kyis dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas par bya'o// zhes brda' sprad nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor la gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du ni slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor mo dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas bar// de'i tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrungs// ces khas blang zhing*/

rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig kyang go ba tsam bya'o// de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa sbyin par bya ste/ bsgrag pa ni 'di skad brjod do// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan par 'gyur ba'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang rdo rje de// shes rab dril bu zhes grags so// slob dpon khyod kyis bzung byas te// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// 'di ni pad ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bya// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus kyis// zhes brjod de/ khas blang pa ni/ byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// zhes pa'am yang na rgyas par bya'o// de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dngos ni/ slob ma'ang bdag nyid lhar 'drar dmigs nas/ zhes pa ste/ de'ang sngon du slob ma rnams kyis gnas gsum du thal mo rim pa ltar sbyar la/ oṃ na mo te hūm̐/ na mo ni hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes phyag byas nas/ rang nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bskyed ces brjod la mngon rtogs ltar bshad la go cha bcing ba'i bar bya'o// ye shes pa ni ye shes dbab pa'i dus gzhug de nas dam tshig gnyis bsgrag pa ni/ rgyas par byed na nag po pa ltar rdo rje spyi bor gzung la/

deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi nang du zhugs kyis ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ rdo rje snying khar bzung la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod la/ de nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi lce la bzhag la/ gzhung gi bu khyod ces pa'i tshig lngas bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig kyang lag pa'am rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ gzhung gi khyod kyis ces pa'i tshig bzhin brjod do// de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ dang por maṇ+ḍal phul la// rdo rje 'chang chen pos bdag la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang dpal he ru ka dbab par mdzad du gsol ces brjod nas/ rdzas dang 'dug stangs bzhi byas la/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags la ti sta zhes pa btags la dbab po// ting nge 'dzin ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kha ba bab pa ltar byon nas bdag la thim par bsgom pa'am/ yang na tsar+ya pa'i ltar byas kyang nyan gsungs so// sku gsung thugs la babs pa'i rtags gzhan dang 'dra'o// de'i rjes la rdo rje'i glu yang spros pa la dga' na blang*/ mi dga' na mi dgos/ de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ thog mar me tog dor te/ bla ma'i sku lha so bdun du gnas pa'i thugs kha'i gtso bo'am/ yang na rang gi lha gang yin pa la dor ba dmigs te/ tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ pra ti dza badz+ra ho zhes dor nas/ de nas spyan dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ta lang hri/

ces brjod la gdong g.yogs dbye/ lus dkyil 'khor bstan pa dngos ni/ gzhung gi phyi ni zhes brjod/ de nas bdag nyid ces pa'i don/ snying kha na dpal he ru ka'o// zhes bya ba nas/ gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar gyi lha dang gnas rgyas par bshad do// de rnams ni sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi dbang la bcu bzhi yod kyang bzhir 'dus te/ bum dbang rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa dang*/ gsang dbang shes rab ye shes bzhi pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ thog mar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing*/ kun mkhyen ces pa'i tshig bzhis/ lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo/ dbang dngos la bdun las/ dang po chu dbang ni/ slob ma la ting nge 'dzin bstan pa dang dus cig tu/ rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dang*/ mi bskyod rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor dgug cing gzhug ste/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing bstod par bsgoms nas/ ngag tu/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha'i chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// zhes pa dang*/ rtsa sngags la shri tsakra zhes btags so// de ston pa'i gzhung ni/ rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i tshig bcu bzhi'o/ gnyis pa cod pan ni/ bris pa la sogs pa tshig rkang bcu gcig ste/ dbu rgyan rin chen rigs kyi he ru kar bskyed la/ thor tshug cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag pa'i dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes bya ba'i tshig dang*/ oṃ sarba la sogs pas bya'o// gsum pa rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dziṃ pad la sogs pa tshig dgu ste/ gzhan ni bskyed chog yin la/ dpal ldan ces pa'i tshig bzhis dbang bskur ro// bzhi po dril bu ni/ kham̐ yig la sogs pa'i tshig brgyad dang*/ phyed kyis bskyed chog yin la/ phyed kyis/ 'di ni zhes pa'i tshig bzhi ngag tu brjod nas dbang sbyin no// lnga pa ming gi dbang ni/

dpa' bo la sogs tshig brgyad sngags dang bcas pa ste/ dpa' bo la sogs tshig bzhi ni/ sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad yin la/ de la sngags dang sbrel lo// gzhan tshig bzhi ni ting nge 'dzin dang ji ltar sbyin pa'o// ming ni/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ zhes gtso bo la 'am yang na ser sna yon tan rdo rje/ mi bskyod/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ 'dod chags dpag med rdo rje/ gti mug rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ phrag dog don yod rdo rje/ zhes gang la me tog phog pa'i ming sbyin no// bud med la rdo rje snyems ma/ rdo rje spyan ma/ rdo rje ma ma ki/ rdo rje gos dkar mo/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/ rdo rje sgrol ma zhes sbyin no// de ltar dbang lnga po bskur ba'i gnas lus la bskur/ lus kyi dri ma 'khrud cing*/ lha bsgom pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// rim pa so so'i dgos pa ni/ zhe sdang ser sna/ 'dod chags phrag dog gti mug rnam par dag cing*/ me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam nyid so sor rtog pa/ bya ba grub pa/ chos dbyings rnams kyi yon tan thob par byed pa'o// zhes dus cig tu bshad kyang chog /so sor bshad kyang btub bo// sngags kyi dbang me tog dang 'brel pa ni tshig gnyis te/ de'ang bdag nyid dang slob ma lhar gsal ba'i snying zla ba la sngags phreng gsal bar bsgoms pa la/ bdag gi zhal nas slob ma'i zhal du zhugs par bsgoms te lan gsum sbyin te/ tshig tu ni/ rig pa 'di la sbyin lags kyis/ bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes pas sam/ med kyang rung ngo*/ kha cig 'di sngon la mdzad kyang 'di rang du byas na 'thad par sems so// rdo rje'i brtul shugs kyi dbang ni gnyis las/ dang po thun mong pa ni/ skad cig gis slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms la/ gzhung gi 'di de zhes pas sbyin no// thun mong ma yin pa ni/ g.yas su rdo rje ḍa ma ru/

g.yon du thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ tshangs skud byin la/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ces pa'i tshig bzhis sbyin cing brda' don kyang cung zad sprad do/ lung bstan pa ni/ bdag nyid ces tshig lngas ji ltar bya ba'o// 'di ltar ces pa la sogs tshig lnga sngags dang bcas pas ngag tu brjod cing*/ ming nas smos te der 'gyur ro zhes bya'o// dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod ni/ khams gsum zhes pa'i tshig brgyad de/ mgo thog tu lag pa bzhag nas bya ste/ gnas skabs 'di rang du bya ba'am yang na tsa rgya pas/ dbugs dbyung gsang dbang dang 'brel/ gzengs bstod bzhi pa dang 'brel zhes kyang zer la/ yang na thams cad kyi ting la byas kyang rung zer ro/ gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la gsum yod pa las/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gsol ba gdab zhes so// de'i tshig ni gzhung gi tshig bzhi yis so// de yang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du 'gro bas bya'o// dbang bskur ba dngos la lnga las/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ slob ma rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i phyir dbang stegs la bzhag la/ yang rnam rgyal/ bum pa blangs te/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ de nas la sogs pa'i tshig bcu'o// gzhan tshig bzhi yis ni dbang gi tshigs su bcad pa'o// dpa' bo dag ces bya ba la sogs pa sngags dang bcas pas ni lhag par gnas par bya'o// des nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i phyir mchod pa'i las bya ba ni/ dpa' bo dang zhes pa'o/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ rgyas par byed na lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /zhes sbyin no// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes dril bu g.yon du byin la/

chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong bsgrag snyam pa gyis zhes brjod do// de nas/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// deng khyod kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyis la dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis cig ces brjod do// de ltar ston pa yang de nas zhes so// rjes gnang ni/ gnyis las 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ni/ gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa'i tshig drug go /gzhan don gyi rjes gnang ni/ dpa' bo zhes tshig bcu gsum mo// gsum pa slob ma'i bya ba ni/ bya ba zhes pa la sogs pa tshig drug go /gnyis pa gsang dbang la gsum las/ 'di dag kyang slob dpon 'dis las rgya dang bcas pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa las/ dang po mtshams sbyar ba ni de nas la sogs pa'i tshig drug go /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyabs med skyob pa la sogs tshig brgyad de maṇ+ḍal phul la bya'o// dngos gzhi ni lnga ste/ dang po phyag rgya ni/ sa bon lnga ni/ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ am̐ rnams te/ des mtshon pa'i phyag rgya phyi dang nang du lnga lnga ste/ 'on kyang phyir bzhi yin no zhes pa'o// byang chub kyi sems bsgrub pa ni/ dpa' bo zhes pa la sogs pa rnams so// rtog pa gzhom pa ni/ gang zag gi bye brag gi skur lugs gsum po tshigs bcad dang bcas pa ste/ tshig bcu gnyis so// slob mas lan ji ltar bya ba ni sngags dang tshig drug go /sbyin pa'i tshul ni tshig bdun dang*/ sbyin pa dngos tshig gsum yin no// 'di rnams kyi grol lam pa'i dbang du byas pa'i lag len ni 'di yin te/ sngar nas thod par 'o ma'am chang la bdud rtsi lnga sbyar la/ 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems mu tig lta bu byung bas thod pa gang bar bsgoms la/ gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su ting nge 'dzin ni/

bla ma dang he ru ka yab yum dbyer med kyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems 'od zer bdag gi ngag la thim nas dbang bskur bar bsgoms la/ ji ltar la sogs tshig bdun gyis thod pa mgrin pa'am mgor bzhag la 'di de ces pa tshig lngas lce la bzhag go /de ltar dbang ngag la bskur zhing*/ ngag gi dri ma dag nas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro// zhes don cung zad bshad do// gsum pa shes rab ye shes la bdun las/ dang po ni de nas zhes tshig lngas mtshams sbyar ro// gzungs dang zhes tshig drug gis maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa'o// gsum pa'i rten tshigs bcad dang bcas te sbyin pa ni bla mas zhes so// sbyin pa'i tshig zungs shig la sogs tshig brgyad do// de nas lha mos dam tshig dri ba ni/ tshig brgyad kyis bla mas brjod de lha mos brjod par bsam zer ro// lan ni/ de nas dpa' bo/ ji ltar la sogs tshig bzhi bya'o// dam tshig dang ldan pa la dgyes nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dris lan ni/ de la lha mo zhes pa'i tshig brgyad kyis rtsa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma bstan na/ e bam̐ la sogs tshig bcus man ngag brjod pa'o/ dpa' bo des lha mo lan ni/ sngags skyes la sogs tshig lnga'o// rjes gnang ni/ de la sogs tshig bcu bzhi'o// de rnams kyi lag len ni/ 'dir dngos kyi dbang du byas pa yin kyang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la gzung dang 'dzin pa skyob pa'i skyabs zhes tshig drug gis gsol ba lan gsum du btab la/ de nas bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i yum las cig chad nas slob ma la gzhug cing*/ dngos su sin dhu ra sngags dang bcas te snying khar byugs nas/ zung zhig ces tshig brgyad brjod la/ de nas slob dpon gyis nang gi sngags skyes rang la yod pa ngo sprad pa ni/ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas// dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin te/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor las// de nyid bcom ldan shes rab ma/

ces pas/ rang gi rtsa gsum 'dus mdo nas/ a las me 'bar nas/ spyi bo nas byang chub kyi se mas zhu/ 'khor lo bzhi la/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral dang*/ lhan cig skyes dga' ngo sprad do// de nas spyi bor lag pa bzhag la/ de nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// zhes pa'i tshig lngas gnang ba sbyin no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang 'di ni/ yid la bskur/ yid kyi dri ma dag nas/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// zhes brda' don sprad do// dbang bzhi pa la gnyis las/ mdor bstan ni/ rim pa la sogs tshig gnyis so// rgyas bshad ni/ sems nyid la sogs tshig bcu gnyis so// 'di yang bskur ba'i dus su/ dang por maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' drin gyis// deng 'dir dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// stong nyid shes rab mdzes ma yi// bzhi pa'i bka' drin skyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas gzhung gi tshig bcu gnyis po brjod nas de'i don/ da ltar dbang gsum pa'i lhan cig skyes pa/ rtog bral bde ba chen po yis kyang mtshon du med pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa 'di la brten nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang/ bla na med pa'i byang chub mnyes pa yin pas/ 'di dang bral bar mi bya'o zhes ngo sprad do// de ltar dbang bzhi pa 'di lus ngag yid gsum la bskur zhing*/ de kho na'i skal pa can du byed la/ gsum ka'i dri ma dag pa'o zhes bshad do// yang na gong gi tshig drug bshad la/ 'og gi tshig brgyad kyis rjes gnang byas kyang rung ngo*// mjug gi don ni gnyis te/ dbang gi mjug sdud dngos ni/ chu sogs zhes tshig dgu ste/ de yang slob dpon dril bu pa'i bzhed pas/ chu cod pan rdo rje dril bu ming dang lnga/ sngags dang drug brtul zhugs gnyis cig tu byas pa dang bdun/

slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi ste/ gsol ba gdab cing dam tshig sbyin pa/ de'i bum dbang*/ dngos/ rjes gnang dang bcu gcig gong ma gsum dang bcu bzhi po 'di/ brda' yin pas nang du shes par bya'o// zhes bzhed par snang ngo*// zhar la de kho na nyid kyi bskyang thabs gsungs pa ni/ phyi ni zhes pa'i tshig bcu gnyis te/ rim lnga dang mthun pas 'dir bshad pa ma byas so// de nas rjes su slob mas ji ltar 'byor pa'i longs spyod lus dang bcas pa phul te/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams tshogs dang gtor mas mnyes par bya ste/ dga' ston chen po bya'o// de rnams kyi rim pa yang mchod khrigs ltar bya'o// mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsngo ba ni/ dbang bskur zhes tshig bzhi'o// phyag rgya chen po grub pa dpal dril bu pa'i dbang gi chu bo'i mtshams sbyor gsal bar bstan pa'o// rdzogs so// bde mchog 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las// byung ba'i lus dkyil dbang gi rim pa la// mkhas 'dod cho ga'i sbyar bshad mang mthong yang*// rnal 'byor dgongs pa ma yin rang 'dod yin// 'dir ni bla ma'i zhal las legs rgyud cing*// mkhas 'dod rtog pa bcad nas rang gzhung dang*// mthun par blo dman rnams la phan bya'i phyir// rang byung rdo rje zhes byas sbyar ba yin// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med kyis/ 'gro rnams thar pa'i lam du smin byas te// rim gnyis don gyi gshog pa rab rgyas nas// thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' la spyod par shog /mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub mngon sum du brnyes pa'i/ pu rangs pa prad dz+nya ghir ti la 'ongs pa'i bzhed pa 'di/ lug lo zla ba dang po la lha stengs su sbyar ba'o// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod cig bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ ༈ //dril bu pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi yig sna bzhugs so// bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// in tra'i mdog can dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// srid gsum sgrol mdzad drag po 'dul byed khro bo'i sku// snying rje'i gar ldan rnal 'byor ma dpal lhan cig pa'i// rol pa'i sku mnga' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal nas// 'khor lo sdom par rab gsungs pa// zab mo mngon par rtogs pa'i rim// dril bu zhabs kyis snang mdzad pa// de 'dir cung zad gsal bar bya// dpal dril bu pas mdzad pa'i bsgrub thabs 'di nyams su len par 'dod pas/

rten gyi gang zag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa la gzhol ba'i blo rgya chen po dang ldan pa/ rang gi rgyud rtse cig par rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid du grub par 'dod cing*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la sogs pa rgya chen po/ rgyud dang man ngag dbang bskur ba ji lta ba bzhin thob nas dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag des/ rgyud sde 'og ma pa ltar phyi rol gyi lha'i rtog pa spang zhing*/ mnyam pa nyid chen po'i don khong du chud par byas te nyams su blang bar bya'o// de'ang bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ 'di ltar nyams su blangs te/ re shig snga bar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i glu// hūm̐ rol gcig rol gcig dgyes par rol// bde ba chen po'i rdo rje ni// bde ba chen po'i ro nyid las// 'di nyid du ni bzhengs su gsol// ces so// sgyu ma lta bu'am/ yi ge bdun pa'i sngags kyi sgras sad par mos te/ bdud rtsi ri lu'am/ chang la sbyar ba gang yang rung pas kha dag par byas nas/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gnas pa las thar bar bya ba dang*/ bde ba chen po dang phrad par bya zhing*/ de nyid dang mi 'bral ba'i nye ring med par sems bskyed nas/ shri he ru ka ham̐ zhes// shri ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// de'i don dang ldan pas yid dag par bltas la/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ri rī li lī e ā+ai o ā+au aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ngag sngags kyi dag pa/ de nyid kyi ngang las bdag gi lus zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ thugs khar zla ba 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du/

zhabs kyu bya ba grub/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le dang bam̐ gnyis su med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid du bsgom pas dug gsum sbyangs te/ 'od zer 'phros pas sngon nyid nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la bkug ste/ oṃ mahā ghu ru/ shri he ru ka/ na mo te hūm̐/ na mo ni hūm̐/ na mo na ye hūm̐/ zhes phyag byas la/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod de/ ā+oṃ a:badz+ra bi na hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra wam̐ se hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ran tse hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra mu kun ḍe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ha se hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra la se hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra ghir ti hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra nir ti hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra pus pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra ḍa pe hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra gan dhe hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra dhar she hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra ra se hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra par she hūm̐/ oṃ a badz+ra dhar rme hūm̐/ zhes pi wang ma sngon mo/ gling bu ma ser mo/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu/ rnga bzlum ma dmar mo/ bzhad ma dmar ser/ sgeg mo sngon mo/ glu ma ser mo/ gar ma ljang khu/ me tog ma ser mo/ bdug spos ma dud kha/ mar me ma dmar mo/ dri chab ma ljang khu/ gzugs ma dkar mo/ ro ma dmar mo/ reg ma ljang khu/ chos ma dkar mo rnams kyis phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ oṃ pañca a mri ta puñca me ka sa mud tra spa ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma rnams kyis sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lngas nang dang*/ gsang ba dang mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod nas/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams la yid rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ lam rten pa rnams gzhan nas rgyas par ji skad bshad pa bzhin nam/

yang na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// byang chub myur du bdag skyabs mchi// 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// ces lan gsum gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs so// de nas skad cig gi sngags brjod kyang rung*/ ma brjod kyang rung bas de thams cad rang gi lus la gzhug cing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes spros pas bral ba la mnyam par bzhag pa ni sngon 'gro'o// de nas skad cig gis rten gzhal yas khang rang gi lus nyid la grub par blta ste/ ci skad bshad pa'i 'byung ba rims brtsegs dang*/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// de steng dham̐ skyes sum cu gnyis/ snying khar chus skyes 'dab ma brgyad// dur khrod rnams ni dbang po'i sgo// lpags pa rdo rje ra bas te// ba spu mda'i dra ba las/ ye shes lnga'i me 'od 'bar// zhes pa'i don gsal bar bya'o// de nas lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed cing rims kyis gsal gdab pa ni/ snying khar pad ma'i dbus kyi nyi zla'i steng gi hūm̐ bam̐ las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang*/ phyi'i he ru ka gsal gdab pa gzhung nyid du gsal lo// nyams dgu ni/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod cing drag shul 'jig rung pa// snying rje rngam zhing zhi ba yi/ zhes sku gsung thugs kyi gar ro// mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i sku mdog dang gzugs can/ snying kha'i pad ma'i phyogs la g.yon bskor gyis mam̐ lam̐ pam̐ tam̐ las bskyed cing*/ mtshams rnams su bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams bum pa la gnas pa'i pad ma'i snod du bdud rtsi dang bcas pa bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o// de nas pu dza la sogs pa'i yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi brjod ma thag tu de dag gi gnas su 'khor lo zur drug pa sngon po dang*/

dmar po dang*/ dkar po dbus khong stong la yi ge de nyid las byung ba'i thugs gsung sku'i 'khor lo gsal gdab pa ni gzhung las ji skad bshad pa bzhin te/ sa bcu yongs su dag pa zhal cig phyag gnyis pa phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ stag gi sham thabs can/ gar dgu dang ldan pa'o/ thams cad kyang gtso bo la gzigs pa'o/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ snying kha'i phyi bskor gyi 'dabs ma brgyad la hūm̐ ring po brgyad las gyur pa'i kha gdong ma sngon mo/ 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ phag gdong ma ser mo/ mtshams ma dag ni phyogs kyi kha dog phyed phyed 'dzin pa/ gzhan dag ni snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhin no// de dag kyang sor mo la sogs pa gnas kyi dbye ba mang du 'dug kyang*/ ngo bo gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ yang dag par spong ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang/ dbang po dang*/ stobs dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam rnams kyi bdag nyid do// de nas oṃ sarba bhi ra go gi ni ka ya wa ka tsi ta badz+ra sa bha ad ma ko ham̐/ bdag gis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang*/ 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku rnams dang*/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dbyer med par gyur nas gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin yin snyam du dran pa lan ga sum byas la*/ oṃ badz+ra shud dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud dho haṃ zhes brjod pas/ lha rnams kyi spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang*/ snying khar oṃ ā hūm̐ dkar po dang dmar po dang mthing ka/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab bo// de nas ji skad bshad pa'i gnas su oṃ ha la sogs pa yig 'bru nyid lha rnams kyi kha dog dang mthun par go cha dgod pa bya'o// lha nyid du 'god na/ rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/

g.yas dmar ba/ g.yon nag po/ dbus dkar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag na rdo rje dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang*/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ g.yon na dril bu dang*/ thod pa dang*/ kha ṭam̐ ga dang*/ gzhan ni zhal cig phyag bzhi pa ste/ g.yas dang po 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ ral gri/ 'og ma ḍa ma dang*/ g.yon rnams thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga'o// de dag gi kha dog ni dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ nag po ser po ljang khu'o// de bzhin du phag mo ni/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon ljang dbus dmar/ phyag g.yas na gri gug lcags kyu/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga zhags pa/ gzhan dag ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi la/ g.yas ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga rim pa ltar/ kha dog dmar po dang sngon po/ dkar po ser po/ du ba'i mdog rnams su bsgom mo zhes gsungs te/ 'dir ni yig 'bru lha'i rang bzhin can du bsgom pa rang legs par sems so// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor ro// pheṃ zhes brjod nas snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho zhes brjod pas rang la bstim nas/ oṃ yo ga shud dho sarba dha sa bha bā shu dho ham̐/ ces brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam pa ni ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// yang sngar bzhin dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma bzhin du mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ ci ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur nas/ bkra shis kyi glu dang*/ bgegs bskrod pa dang*/ mchod pa mdzes pa ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas gtso bo yab yum la rdo rje sems pa'o// mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs la mi bskyod pa/ gsung la 'od dpag med/ sku la rnam snang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan no// de nas 'od zer la phar 'phros shing tshur la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ mchod khrigs nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ phyi nang gsang ba dang*/ phreng ba'i sngags dang*/ rkang pa brgyad pa la sogs pa'i mchod bstod bya'o/ de ltar lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu la mi skyo ba'i bar du bsgom par bya'o// bsnyen pa ni thugs kha'i he ru ka yab yum gyi gnas rnams su sngags bkod la/ bzlas pa'i yan lag bla ma'i zhal la byung ba bzhin/ mi rus kyi phreng ba la sogs pa gang yang rung ba blangs te mi skyo'i bar du bzlas par bya'o// de dag ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lus so// yan lag ni gsum las/ dus thams cad du mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i tshe yang sum bha ni dang go cha la sogs pas bsrungs te/ snod bcud thams cad he ru ka'i sku/ sgra thams cad sngags/ rnam rtog chos nyid kyi rang bzhin du lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa dang*/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa la gnas shing*/ rkang ba brgyad pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyang mchod par bya'o// gnyis pa bza' ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ me rlung gi sbyor bas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil dag tu 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang*/ dpa' mo la sogs pa'i sngags bkod nas/ nang du gtum mo'i me dang lha rnams gsal bar dmigs te/ nang gi sbyin bsreg gi tshul du zos nas/ lhag ma u tsi tas 'byung po la sbyin no// gsum pa gtor ma ni ji ltar bsham pa ste/ swa bha bās nyes pa sbyangs te/ yam̐ las rlung*/

ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyid pu/ a las snod ka pa la/ nang du gho ku dha ha na/ bhi mu ma ra shu las sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ oṃ dz+riṃ kham̐ las ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid du dmigs te/ oṃ ā hūm̐ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa kha chod kyi tshul du bltas la/ 'od zer 'phros nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug cing*/ rdo rje'i thal mo kha gyen du phye la oṃ a ra li zhes bya ba'i sngags dang*/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor la phul te/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par bsam mo// de nas kha khwa la sogs pa'i sngags kyis 'byung po thams cad la mchod de/ mchod pa dang bstod pa/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la gshegs su gsol lo// da ni gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i don ni/ snying kha'i he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa zhu bas/ lha mo rnams kyang zhu ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i lhag pa byang chub kyi sems dngul chu lta bu las 'od zer lnga rab tu 'phro ba sran ma'i rdog po tsam pa dmigs te/ lha gzhan dag kyang bzhu ba de nyid la sdus nas rlung kha sbyar du bsgoms pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde gsal mi rtog pa skye zhing*/ rtags bcu yon tan brgyad mngon du 'gyur ro// rgyas par rim pa lnga las gsungs so// da ni mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ston te / kha ṭ+wām̐ ga ni lha'i sku zhes pa la sogs pa tshig rkang brgyad kyi don/ shes rab spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin las/ lha sku bzhin lag dang kha dog gi rnam pa thabs ltar du shar ba ni/ rim pa gnyis dbyer med pa ste/ gzugs sogs kyi snang ba rang bzhin kyang shes rab kyis rgyas gdab par bya zhing*/ ḍa ma ru'i sgra ltar phyi nang gi ngag thabs su shar ba/ a li ka li'i rang bzhin/ stong pa shes rab kyis rgyas gdab ste/

de yang kye'i rdo rje las/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga gzugs shes rab ste/ thabs kyi gzugs kyis cang te'u ces pa dang*/ rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do// zhes so// de bzhin du nyin mo snang ba'i cha ni thabs yin la/ mtshan mo snang med ni shes rab ste/ de gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsgrub pa'i sems kyis mi bya ba ci yang med pa ni dgag bsgrub med pa'o// de rtogs par byed pa la brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la sogs pa bzhis nyams nga med pa seng ge ltar bsgrub pa'o// yang tshig bzhis nang don mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du bsgrub par byed 'dod pa rnams sbyang gzhi phung po lnga sbyong ba la rigs lngar snang la/ drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa sbyong ba ni/ he ru ka yin te// yid kyi yul chos yin pa sbyong ba ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs su bstan zhes pa'o// 'di dag ni rim gnyis dbyer med du sbyor ba'o// de ltar lam nyams su blang ba'i 'bras bu ni/ sems ni ngal bso zhes tshig drug gi lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la gnas par 'dod pas/ lam bskyed rdzogs la ngal bso nas ye shes mngon du gyur pas/ theg pa dman pa lta bu'i mya ngan las 'das pa bstan pa ma yin cing gzhan don dang bcas te sangs rgyas su gyur la/ gnas skabs su yang 'chi ba la sogs pas mi 'jigs te mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par byed do// mthar thug ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i don te/ mjug bsdu pa ni/ cho ga sna tshogs ces tshig drug gis/ de ltar khyad par can gyi thabs nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa/ rgyud du sbas pa rnams rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal dril bu pas snang bar mdzad pa'o// lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsgrub pa'i thabs/ rang byung rdo rjes cung zad gsal bar byas pa'o// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi snying po'i don// pu rangs lo ts+tsha las rgyud zhal gyi gdams pa 'di// bla ma rnams kyis mdzad las gzhan du ci zhig yod// 'on kyang nyung 'dus gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba des// 'gro rnams dpal ldan he ru ka dpal nyid thob shog

/nyes pa mchis na bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod// bla ma rgya dang*/ gnyan ras kyis rtsom gzhi mdzad pa yod kyang go dka' zhing mang grags pas/ 'dir shin tu 'dus par byas so// sbrul lo zla ba brgyad pa la lha stengs su sbyar ba/ rdzogs so/// / ༈ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'thad pa lung sbyor bzhugs so// dpa' 'khor lo bde mchog lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// khro 'dzum in tra ni la'i mdog can rdo rje dril bus rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khyud// yum dang g.yas brkyang bde bas dgyes pa'i gar dgus nyi ma'i dbus su rnam par sbyor// drang srong khros pa'i sku la 'od zer sngon pos sa gsum khyab mdzad a ta ha yi gsung*// rus pa'i rgyan can stag lpags sham thabs gangs ri pho mo zhabs kyis gnon// de lta'i bde mchog 'khor lo de ni phyi rol ma yin rang lus gdod nas grub// rdul tshon bcos ma spangs phyir dril bu pa'i mkha' spyod grub pa'i bsgrub thabs 'di// chu bo ljon shing tshogs kyis rnam rgyan bya bran skad snyan sgrogs pa'i gnas// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma lus mkhyen pa'i bla ma nyid la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul// lus dkyil 'di ni bde mchog dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas rjes su gnang ba mdzad// dril bu pas mdzad bsgrub thabs 'di ni bdag blos gsal bar mi nus bla ma'i gsung*// sgra bsgyur pu rangs lo ts+tsha'i bshad srol brjed par mi bya sems la gyis zhes gnang*// sgrub thabs nyams blangs sangs rgyas 'byung phyir mngon rtogs 'di ni u dhu bha rar bshad// bla ma dril bu pa 'di ni dpal dha ri ka pa'i gdams ngag brten nas lo bcu gnyis bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i mthar/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan na/ bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ a bhi da na dang*/ sam̐ bu ta gsum la lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsgrub thabs phyung nas/

dbang po yang rab kyi don du thig dang rdul tshon bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor spangs te/ ma bcos pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshe ga cig gis rdo rje 'chang thob pa mkha' spyod grub pa 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du bstan nas tshogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa bya bar dgongs te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgrub thabs 'di mdzad/ 'di nyid nas kyang*/ 'gro kun don la sems gzhol ba// ces pas/ gdul bya dbang po rab 'bring gsum rab kyi don du lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs la/ 'bring dang tha ma'i don du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcos ma gsungs te/ de'ang bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor la ngo ma sprad na/ ma bcos pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor zab par mi shes pa dang*/ las dang po pa blo chung ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ma bskur bar nges shes mi skye ba dang*/ rims kyis 'khrid pa dbang po 'bring dang*/ tha ma'i don du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la ngo sprad nas bsgom par gsungs te/ dpal bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor la sogs las gang gi /bcos ma'i sems kyis gang byed pa// phyi rol las rnams gsal byed pas// dang po'i las can rnams la bsngags/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor la blo gro ba rnams kyang*/ rims kyis gdod nas grub pa ma bcos pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor rtogs pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug par gsungs te/ dpal bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma'i sbyor ba rtogs bya'i phyir// bcos ma yis ni bsgom par bya// rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs gyur nas// bcos ma'i sbyor ba phyi rol pas// bcos ma dag ni mi bya'o// dper na gzings la 'jus pa yis// chu bo'i pha rol phyin dor ltar// bcos ma dag kyang de bzhin no// ces gsungs pas lus dkyil 'khor du grub par shes dgos pas 'di nyid nas kyang*/ rang rgyud sngags dang rnal 'byor shes/

ces pas/ rang lus gdod nas grub pa ma bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor/ bla ma brgyud pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid la mkhas pa brnyes pas/ zhal nas ngo sprad dgos te/ bde mchog nges brjod bla ma las/ rnal 'byor dngos grub bla med pa// bla ma'i kha nas rnyed par 'gyur// ces gsungs pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi khyad par lung gis nges shes bskyed cing rigs pas nyams su blangs/ ngo sprad par gsungs/ rgyud bde mchog khrag 'thung mngon 'byung nas/ thams cad bdag nyid du ni gnas// lus ni dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs so// ces pa dang*/ rgyud bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba nas/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim bsgrub pas// lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs so// ces pas/ lung gis rang lus gdod nas ma bcos pa'i lus dkyil 'khor du nges shes bskyed nas/ 'di nyid nas/ phyi rol rnam rtog spangs nas ni// ces pas/ bcos ma'i sa chog thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor spang bar gsungs pa dang*/ lus dkyil 'khor du grub par mdor bstan pa'o// dang po rdul tshon dang ri mo kun spang ba ni/ rgyud bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro las// skyes bu bcos ma'i bya ba rnams// rgyud kyi rjes su 'brengs nas ni// 'bad pas sdug bsngal slong bar byed// phyi rol dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i// bya ba cho ga la 'bad pa// thar pa dang bral phyi rol te// skyes bu nyon mongs 'ba' zhig byed// ces bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor mi bya bar gsungs/ gnyis pa lus dkyil 'khor du grub par bshad pa ni/ rgyas par bla na med pa'i rgyud rdo rje phreng ba nas/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur// sangs rgyas kun gyis yang dag bstan// zur bzhi pa ni mdun rgyab dang*/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so// steng 'og sgo ni dbye ba yis// sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin// ces pa dang*/

rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud// sangs rgyas thod pa las kyang*// gal te bla med byang chub 'dod// lus ni dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// phyi yi dkyil 'khor bya ba med// lha rnams bshig pa tsam gyis ni// sdig pa chen po skye bar 'gyur// des na rdul tshon tsam gyis ni// de bzhin lha rnams dga' mi 'gyur// ces pa'o/ de ltar lus dkyil 'khor du grub pas/ phyi rol rdul tshon ltar 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed mi dgos/ lus kyi dbyibs 'byung ba rims brtsegs su grub par gsungs te/ 'di nyid nas/ rkang pa sum mdo lte snying kha// rlung dang me chu sa yin no// sgal tshigs ri rgyal de bzhin te// lus ni mnyam pa sgo la rlung*// ces pa'o/ de ni dpal sam̐ bhu ta nas gsungs te/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung*/ gzhu yi dbyibs su rnam par gnas// sum mdo me yi gnas su ni// de bzhin gru gsum 'bar ba nyid/ zlum pa rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni// chu ni lte bar rnam par gnas// snying kha yang ni sa nyid de// kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do// sgal tshigs dbyug gu'i gzugs kyis ni// ri rab ri rgyal de bzhin no// de yi spyi bo'i char gnas pa// 'dam skyes 'dam ma sum cu gnyis// dbyangs dang gsal byed mdzes par gnas// ces pas rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang ri rab nyi zla lus la gdod nas grub pas/ bcos ma mi bsgom ces pa'o/ thig kyang gdod nas grub pa ni/ rgyud nges brjod bla ma las/ ku lu ta ni rdo rje dang*// rin po che dang dkyil 'khor thig /sin dhu rdo rje'i thig zlum mo// pu li ra ma la pad ma// ces thig dang sna tshogs pad ma gdod nas lus la grub po// 'di nyid nas kyang*/ kha sbyor phyi nyid legs shes pa// thugs khar a ba dhu ti hūm̐/ bcom ldan nang gi bdag nyid do// ces pa'i don bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud nas gsungs te/ bdag nyid khrag 'thung dpal byas nas// de 'og khrag 'thung dpal dran bya// 'khor lo 'di yi snying khar dgod// ces pas bdag nyid spyi'i khrag 'thung zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par bskyed pa'i thugs kar/

dhu ti hūm̐ las mi bskyod bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa la yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas 'khyud pa/ de ltar grub pa bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba las gsungs pa ni/ rtsa'i gnas dang yul rnams ni// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i grangs yin te// de rnams dbus kyi rtsa gsum gang*// thams cad khyab cing rten pa'o// ces pa g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis na/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba/ bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rtsa ni/ bum pa dang pad snod du grub pas/ lha mo bzhi rin 'byung gi rigs kyis rin chen phreng bas mdzes pa dgod/ 'di nyid nas kyang*/ 'di dag gnas su rnal 'byor ma// rtsa yin dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi// lus kyi khams su brtag par bya/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud sam̐ bhu ta nas/ he ru ka la sogs pa'i lha// rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag 'byung*// lus kyi dkyil 'khor nyams dga' ba// ces pas rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsungs pa ltar rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro mar gyur/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bor gyur/ thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi gdod nas grub pa ni/ rgyud nges brjod nas/ dza lan dha ra thugs 'khor lo// u rgyan gnas ni gsung 'khor lo/ ar bu ta ni sku'i 'khor lo/ ces pa dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi lus la gdod nas grub po// de nas snying kha'i bde chen 'khor lo'i phyi rol gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ dam tshig 'khor lo gdod nas grub pa ni/ 'di nyid nas kyang*/ rnal 'byor dam tshig mnyam nyid che// ces gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud nges brjod nas/ oṃ tre dag ni shar gyi sgo// tri sha ku ni lho yi sgo// ko sa la ni nub kyi sgo// ka ling ka ni byang gi sgo// ra me sha ra me yi phyogs// de bi ko tra bden bral phyogs// ma la ba ni rlung gi phyogs// ka ma ru pa dbang ldan phyogs// ces gsungs pas sgo mtshams ma brgyad ci lta ba bzhin gdod nas grub pa/

rtog med mnyam pa nyid du spyod pa'i brdar ro'i gdan la dam tshig gi 'khor lo grub bo// 'di nyid nas/ rgyal rnams rab mdzes he ru ka'i// lus ni dkyil 'khor du 'dod do// ces pa'i don te/ rgyud nges brjod nas/ gri ha de ba lha'i snam bu/ so ra sh+sha ni rin chen pha gu// su wa rna dra ba dra phyed// na ga ra ni rnga yab dang*// dril bu rgyal mtshan ba dan no// shar gyi rta babs lam pa ka /kan tsi lho yi rta babs yin// hi ma la ya ni nub rta babs// pre ta pu ra byang rta babs// ces gsungs pas lus gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi dkyil 'khor du grub bo// des na thig las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor khang pa brtseg mar bsgom pa bcos ma yin te/ spang ba'i don no/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol dur khrod brgyad rdo rje ra ba me ri bri ba ni/ phyi rol du yod pa ma yin/ nang lus kyi bu ga brgyad la dur khrod brgyad grub pa yin te/ rdo rje snying po'i 'grel pa las/ dbugs rgyu zhes bya gsang dur khrod// lus ni nang gi dur khrod yin// dngos por rtog pa sna tshogs pa// mi rtog chos kyi dbyings kyi dur// ces gsungs pa dang*/ de'i don phyag rgya chen po'i thig le zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud nas/ lus kyi bu ga brgyad dur khrod chen po brgyad yin par gsungs te/ gtum khrag gzhang kha'i dbyibs can dang*// gsang ba tshang tshing kha ru'o// 'bar ba zhes bya'i dur khrod ni// sna yi bu ga gnyis na gnas// dmyal sogs de bzhin mi bzad pa// mig gnyis na ni gnas pa'o// ha har rgod dang g.yer ka can/ rna ba gnyis la gnas pa'o// de ni bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas kyang*// gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod du// ces pa dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes rtsa rgyud 'grel pa nas kyang gsungs pa ni/ shar gyi dur khrod gtum drag ni/ nang du kha la gnas pa'o// lho yi dur khrod ha ha rgod// nang du sna bug g.yas pa'i rtsa// nub kyi dur khrod mi bzad pa// nang du gnas pa nor bu'i rtsa// byang gi dur khrod tshang tshing ni// nang du sna dbug g.yon pa'i rtsa/

phyi ru dbang ldan dur khrod ni// nang du rna ba g.yon pa'i rtsa// phyi ru rlung gi dur khrod ni// nang du rna ba g.yas pa'i rtsa// phyi ru bden bral dur khrod ni// nang du mig ni g.yas pa'i rtsa// phyi ru me yi dur khrod ni// nang du mig ni g.yon pa'i rtsa// ces pa dang*/ dur khrod brgyad kyi phyi rol du rdo rje ra ba dang*/ me ri bri ba bcos ma yin pas de'i nang du gnas pa ste/ dpal phyag na rdo rje rtsa rgyud 'grel pa las/ lpags pa rdo rje'i ra ba ste// ba spu mda' yi dra ba las// ye shes lnga yi me 'od 'bar// ces pas rdo rje ra ba dang mda'i dra ba dang me ri gdod nas lus la grub pas/ phyi rol bcos ma spang ces pa'o// blo rab kyis lus dkyil 'khor du shes pas spros pa chod pa dang*/ blo 'bring gis 'og nas mngon rtogs spyi don dgus nyams su len pa la gong gi lus dkyil 'khor du grub pa'i bshad pa sbyar nas bsgom par bya'o// ces pu rangs lo ts+tsha ba bzhed/ lus gdod nas dkyil 'khor du grub pa bshad zin te// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid snang ba dha ri ka pa'i bzhed pa bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ a la ka a bha ba dha la na ma/ bod skad du/ dkyil 'khor mngon par snang ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la// btud de bdag gis dkyil 'khor gyi// rim pa rgyud las gang gsungs pa// gsal bar rab tu bshad par bya// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ru// dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum gsungs te// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// phyi la gnyis te rdul tshon dang*// bsgom par bya ba'i rim pa'o// thog mar bri ba'i rim pa ni// bde mchog rgyud pa las shes bya/ bsgom pa'i rim pa 'di lta ste// rdo rje ra ba'i nang dag tu// sgo bzhi kun nas zur bzhi pa// rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan// re ga lnga dang yang dag ldan// ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes// do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan// rin chen rdo rje srad bus spras// de ni spyi tsam bshad pa'o// bye brag rnam par bshad par bya// rdo rje'i sa gzhi chen po la// gnas pa'i khang pa brtseg ma ni// cha chen gtso bo'i 'dom gang ste// de brgyad kun du mnyam pa'o// brtsig pa'i spangs su cha gsum ste// kha cig cha gnyis dag tu 'dod/

zheng la cha bran cig tu 'dod// lnga ldan ma 'dres gsal ba'o// de stengs rin chen pha gu ni// cha bran cig go phyi rol du// phyed lhag rin chen gyis spras pa'o// de steng rin chen be ḍur+ya// cha phyed lhan stengs gzengs khang ste// de la rin chen bre gnas pa'i// phyi nang gnyis las dra ba dang*// dra ba phyed pa rab 'phyang ba'o// gzhan dag pha gu las byung 'dod// de nas thog gi dbyibs bshad bya// brtsig pa'i steng du rgya gram gdung*// 'khor lo pad ma rdo rje dang*// rin chen gdung dang rnam pa lnga// dang po gru bzhi gzhan rnams ni// zlum po'i dbus su rgya gram yin/ de las gyes pa'i gdung rnams ni// 'og ma 'og ma'i steng gnas pas// cha phran bzhi yis mtho bar 'gyur// kun la khor yug re re ste// rgya gram gdung las phyi rol tu// 'dom phyed lhag pas 'dod yon gyi/ snam bu dmar po khebs pa yin// phal cher thog 'di byur bur 'dod// dbus kyi rgya gram de steng du// chos 'khor bcu gsum char khab tog /kun la cha gnyis ldan pa'o// de nas phyogs kyi sgo rnams ni// glo 'bur tshul du gnas pa la// rnam thar tshul du re re la/ sgo ni gsum gsum yod par 'dod// thams cad spangs su cha chen po// phyed dang gnyis gnyis mnyam pa'o// de steng pan reg pha gu dang*// dra phyed gzeng khang khor yug ste// de steng sgo yi gdung gnas pa/ btegs pa'i phyi rol ka ba brgyad// phyogs kyi dbye bas gnyis gnyis so// de steng rta babs cha bzhi ste// re re la'ang pha gu dang*// dra phyed gzeng khang gsum gsum gyis// phye bas bcu gnyis dag tu 'gyur// bcu gnyis zur can bcu gnyis brgyan// de steng gdan la ri dwags bzhi// gzhan ni gnyis gnyis dag tu 'dod// chos 'khor rim pa bcu bcu la// char khab tog gis brgyan pa yin// kha cig sgo ni re re dang*// rta babs phyed pa'am sgo yol tshul// ka ba gnyis kyis btegs pa dang*// stod po che ru 'dod pa'ang yod// phyi rol stegs bu la gnas pa'i// lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod byed pa// gzhi ni lha yi dbye ba yis// 'dir ni thogs dang mtshungs pa nyid// zur dang phyogs ni thams cad du// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// lda ldi'i tshogs kyis mdzes pa'o// sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dga' ba// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// dkyil 'khor chen po spangs pa yin// rdo rje slob dpon rnal 'byor pa// dha ri ka pa'i bzhed pa yin// gnyis pa nang gi dkyil 'khor ni// lus 'di gzhal yas khang du 'gyur// sangs rgyas kun gyis yang dag brten// zur bzhi pa ni mdun rgyab dang*// g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so// steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis// sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin// gzhan yang lus kyi dbye ba yis// gh+ri ha de ba lha snam bu// so'u rat+na rin chen phag

/su wa na ni dra ba phyed// na ga ra ni rnga yab dang*// dril bu rgyal mtshan ba dan no// shar gyi rta babs lam̐ ka ga /kan tsi lho yi rta babs yin// hi mā la ya ni nub rta babs// pri ta pu ra byang rta babs// dur khrod rnams ni dbang po'i sgo// lpags pa rdo rje'i ra ba ste// ba spu mda' yi dra ba las// ye shes lnga yi me 'od 'bar// dkyil ni snying po zhes brjod de// byang chub sems ni bde chen po// de ni blang bar byed pa'i phyir// 'dus pa dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod// de ltar gdod nas grub pa yi// lus ni dkyil 'khor nyid yin te// 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// rgyud rnams kun du gsungs pa yin// gsum pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni// sems kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin te// dpal ldan rnyog pa med pa las// sems kyi dkyil 'khor dag pa ste// rang bzhin med par bsgom par bya// dbus ni chos dbyings rang bzhin te/ me long la sogs ye shes bzhi// shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi'o// sgo bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi// zur bzhi sbyin pa rnam bzhi ste// ting 'dzin yan lag rta babs so// gzhan yang re ga ye shes la// rin chen 'dod pa kun ster ba// dra ba bde stong rang bzhin te// thog gi dbyibs ni rigs lnga'o// ka ba brgyad ni 'phags lam brgyad// rta babs byang chub yan lag bdun// zur ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis te// ri dwags bcu drug byang chub sems// yang na snying rje'i rang bzhin no// dbus kyi gdugs rnams thams cad ni// bcu gsum pa yi bdag nyid do// gzhan ni sa bcu rnam par dag /dril bu'i sgra ni stong nyid sgra// zla ba nyi ma rin chen dang*/ thabs shes dgos pa bsgrub byed pa// 'dod yon ma spangs rtog pa'i don// sbyin sogs pha rol phyin pa rnams// ma 'dres so sor gsal ba yi// dkyil 'khor 'di ni bla na med// sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal bar// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yin// 'di ltar dkyil 'khor rim pa la// rang gzhan 'dod dang brgal lan gyis// dpyad na dpag tu med gyur kyang*// 'di ni rtog ge'i yul min cing*// sangs rgyas rol pa bsam mi khyab// des na rgyud dang bla ma yi// bzhed pa gcig tu bsdus pa 'di// dpal ldan rol pa'i rdo rje yis// snyan ngag tshig rnams spangs nas ni// go bde'i ngag tu byas pa yin// de las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro rnams bde ba che thob shog

/dkyil 'khor mngon par snang ba zhes bya/ i thi/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling mdzes par shog// / ༈ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i snying po bzlas thabs bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dkar mo'i bdag po zil gnon gzi brjid rab 'bar ba// mtshungs med dpal ldan he ru ka la phyag 'tshal nas// rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal las legs 'ongs pa// bzlas pa'i man ngag bdag gis cung zad gsal bar bya// de la 'dir bzlas pa'i don la brten nas nyams su blang ba ni/ rtsa ba gsum la brten nas/ yan lag gi bzlas thabs drug go /dang po ni spro sdu'i bzlas pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa gsum mo// dang po la gsum du 'gyur te/ 'phrin las bzhi'i tshul du sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i bzlas pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i spro bsdu dang*/ rags pa dkyil 'khor la dmigs te bzla ba'o// dang po ni gtso bo'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las/ 'od zer mthing kha byung mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du thim/ mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar thim pas bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar bsam zhing bzlas so// de bzhin du bdag gi thugs ka nas hūṃ las 'od ser po'i tshul du g.yas zhal ser po nas byung*/ gzugs can ma'i zhal du thim gzugs can ma'i thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar thim pas shes rab dang tshe dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas pa'i bsam pas bzlas so// de bzhin zhal dmar po nas 'od zer dmar po dum skyes ma'i zhal nas thim zhing 'gro ba mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du byas te/ dum skyes ma'i thugs ka nas bdag gi thugs kar thim par bsam zhing bzla'o// de ltar zhal ljang khu nas/ lā ma dang 'od zer gyi spro bsdu ljang khus gdug pa can tshar bcad pa'i bsam pas bzlas so// gnyis pa bde ba chen po'i spro bsdu la gnyis las/

dang po ni thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer bdag gi sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas/ yum gyi mkhar byung ste sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs shing thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ bde stong gi rtogs pa skye bar bsam zhing bzlas so// gnyis pa ni yab kyi zhal nas 'od zer lnga'i rang bzhin yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ de dang dus mtshungs par mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te/ yum gyi sku'i dbyibs rgyud yab kyi nor bur zhugs te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bltas pas/ bde stong chen po cig tu 'char ro zhes gsungs so// gsum pa rags pa dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bzla ba ni/ gtso bo'i spyi gtsug gi oṃ dkar po dang*/ mgrin pa'i a dmar po dang*/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ mthing kha las/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha gsum byung nas 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad khyab/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar gyur nas shin tu gsal bar bsgom/ tshur 'dus bdag nyid kyi yi ge gsum la 'dus nas shin tu gsal bar bsgom mo// 'gog pa'i bzlas pa la nyon mongs pa 'gog pa ste bdud bzhi 'joms tshul du bzla' ba zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ bsam/ de'i mthar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ de'i mthar bdud bzhi'i sa bon bam̐ nag po bzhi bsam/ yang na k+ṣa dmar nag bzhi bsams te/ sngags bzlas pas 'khor lo 'khor bas bdud bzhi'i ngo bo gcod par bsam zhing bzlas/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa shas che na nyon mongs pa 'ba' zhig gcod par bsam zhing bzlas 'phral rkyen gyi bar du phung po'i bdud dang 'chi bdag gi bdud 'ba' zhig gcod par bsgom zhing bzlas/ sems rtse cig tu mi gnas na/ lha'i bu'i bdud gcod par bsam zhing bzlas so// rdo rje'i bzlas pa la gnyis te/

rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang phra ba 'od gsal gyi bzlas pa'o// dang po ni rlung dang bstun te/ nang du rngub pa oṃ/ gnas pa āḥ phyir 'phro ba hūm̐ ngo*// de ltar bsgoms te rlung cung zad bzung bas yid kyis yi ge gsum lce rtse g.yo ba tsam du bgrang ngo*// des sems zin/ sems zin pas rlung 'gag des 'od gsal gyi nyams skye zhes gsung ngo*// phra ba 'od gsal du bzla ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i skabs ltar thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od kha dog lnga 'phros te/ sems can thams cad bde mchog tu gyur nas slar bdag la bsdu ba ni rdzogs rim dngos yin no// de ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa rgyud las bshad pa bzhin no// dpal ldan bla med rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho la// rin chen brgyud pa'i rim las bab pa'i don// sang gha la k+ṣa'i zhal las legs 'ongs pa// brjed pas 'jigs phyir rang byung bdag gis bkod// nor 'khrul chad lhag 'gal bar gyur pa rnams// dpal dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
